pages.text: A full busy hive (5 bees of one kind) makes about $(l)210$() trips per hour of work.$(br2)Away from home it makes about 123; boosted (home biome or the queen) about 244.$(br2)Combs per hive-hour = trips x the chance a trip brings that comb home.
A day is 20 real minutes: about 10.9 of day and 9.1 of night. Overworld bees only work in the day, so a real hour holds about 55% of a hive-hour.
